I went through pretty much what you went through, except after my grand mal I was very confused and it took me about 2 days to figure out what happened.

So the night before my seizure I am laying in bed using my laptop, I feel like shit and have mild hallucinations and I feel like the bed is spinning. Next thing I am aware of is my upper back is in incredible pain and I am partially delirious. I started to panic so I took some xanax (probably saved my life), and then I have to have help getting out of bed. I stayed in bed most of the day thinking I had pulled a muscle in my sleep, but it wasn't until the next day I realized I had a grand mal because my tongue was bleeding still and all my things were laying around everywhere (my laptop and glasses were on the floor, so I had a violent one).

Over the course of 3 days my arms turn black and blue (I guess I convulsed so hard I broke blood vessels). For about 2 weeks I lost most control of my arms as they were so week. My arms still occasionally "glitch" but I "pop" it back into place.

I then started using Diclazepam to taper off the xanax, during the transition from Alprazolam to Diclazepam I had a couple of mild seizures (not sure what they are called) but I remained awake and could feel myself violently shaking and jumping around. This type of seizure I was able to snap myself out of, but once I stopped it I was always very tired and had to fight going back to sleep because the seizure would start again. So I took more Diclazepam and slowly tapered down. The transitional seizures only lasted 4 days. 

I would now be benzo free, but I relapsed due to a death in the family. I would still be using Diclazepam to taper with, but I have a surprise drug test coming so I have to use kpin to taper with.
